# Image Filters & Effects

- Route: `/tools/image-filters`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `image`
- Slug: `image-filters`

## Summary

Oil painting, sketch, charcoal, emboss, vintage, swirl, blur, sharpen and more, applied to any photo in one click. (Image tools)

## Details

Sometimes a photo wants to be something else: a sketch for an invitation, an oil painting for a print, an embossed logo, a swirled abstract. Media Manipulator applies ImageMagick's artistic and corrective filters on our servers, from pencil sketch to sharpening, and exports in any image format, optionally cropped, resized and captioned in the same pass.
### What it does
- Artistic: oil painting, sketch, charcoal, emboss, vintage, sepia, swirl, barrel distortion.
- Corrective: blur, sharpen, grayscale.
- Rotations by 45, 90, 180 and 270 degrees in the same select.
- Combine with crop, resize, text overlay and format conversion.
### How to use it
1. Upload an image: Any common format.
2. Pick a filter: Oil painting is preselected.
3. Convert: ImageMagick renders the effect.
4. Download: Save the result.
### Supported formats
- Input: jpg, png, webp, gif, avif, heic, bmp, tiff
- Output: jpg, png, webp, avif, gif
### Technical details
- Oil painting and charcoal are radius-based and scale with image size; resize to 1500 to 2500 px for the strongest effect.
- Sketch and emboss work best on images with clear edges and good contrast.
- Effects are rendered into the pixels; keep the original.
### Use cases
- Pencil portrait: Sketch filter on a photo for a card.
- Painted print: Oil painting for a canvas print.
- Embossed logo: Emboss a flat logo.
- Sharpen a scan: Bring up edges on a soft scan.
### FAQ
Q: Can I adjust the strength?
A: The filters use fixed, tuned strengths. Resize the image larger or smaller to change how strong a radius-based effect looks.
Q: Can I stack filters?
A: One filter per pass; run the result through the tool again for a second.
Q: Is there an AI style transfer?
A: No. These are classic ImageMagick effects, which run instantly.
Q: Which filter works for a logo?
A: Emboss or charcoal on a high-contrast logo.

## Routing

When to send a visitor here: Use when someone wants a one-click artistic effect on a photo: oil painting, sketch, charcoal, emboss, vintage, sepia, swirl or barrel distortion, or a simple blur, sharpen or grayscale. Typical asks: "make my photo look like a sketch".
When to send them elsewhere: For careful tone and colour correction with layers use Aperture (aperture). For a tunable black and white use Black & white photo (black-and-white-photo). To blur only faces use Blur Faces in Photo (blur-faces-in-photo).
Related tools: grayscale-image (plain black and white or sepia); blur-image (a whole-image blur only); sharpen-image (a single-click sharpen); aperture (full layer-based photo editing)
